prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Radon (라돈) itself — the sovereign of the Radon Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: radon: a colourless, odourless radioactive noble gas, one of the heaviest of all gases, breathed out by radium as it decays and identified in 1900 as radium emanation; seeping up from uranium in the rock, it drifts low and pools unseen in cellars and basements; half of it is gone in under four days; frozen solid it glows bright yellow, turning orange-red as it grows colder. Palette: translucent mist grey, pale yellow glow, cellar-stone blue-grey, a faint orange-red ember.

World (fixed): an old manor of an invisible guest: a pale mist that never rises but drifts low along the floors and pours down the stairs, vaulted stone cellars where a breath seeping up from the rock below quietly pools, a guest room no one has slept in that always feels as if someone has just left. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) a long floor-length robe with a high collar, wide sleeves and a shoulder mantle — a tall, mysterious mage's silhouette; 2) a light breastplate and bracers with robe panels split from the waist — half armor, half robe; 3) large metal feathered wing ornaments spreading from the shoulders or back and a wing-shaped head ornament — the wings make the shape; 4) angular, spiked dark plate armor and a long cape with torn edges — a sharp, menacing silhouette; 5) thin leaf-patterned armor plates and flowing light fabric panels with a slender circlet — a slender, graceful silhouette; 6) a fur cloak, leather straps, minimal metal plates and bone and tooth ornaments — a rugged, wild warrior silhouette; 7) a floor-length priestly vestment with gold-trimmed stoles and a tall head ornament — a long, devout silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): translucent mist grey, pale yellow glow, cellar-stone blue-grey, a faint orange-red ember.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): translucent mist-grey hair that trails downward like heavy smoke, faintly glowing pale yellow at the ends. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Rn) and atomic number (86) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Detailed design for this fourth option: Choose silhouette 3, large metal feathered wing ornaments and wing-shaped head ornament. Make the wings from descending nested stone-blue silver feathers, hollow channels releasing pale-yellow mist downward, with orange-red tips evoking the frozen element's light. Adult woman with a softly rounded face, warm copper eyes, subtle muted rose lips and a composed gentle gaze. Mist-grey hair in two long loosely braided tails with glowing pale-yellow ends, straight soft bangs. A sculpted short armored dress with open shoulders, deep neckline, opaque chest and hip coverage, long split back panels, thigh-high armored boots. Wings are costume architecture, two human arms distinct from them; both empty hands fully visible at her sides. Frontal full-body view in the manor's abandoned vaulted gallery, an empty chair and an open stone cellar stair behind, low mist flowing down the stairs; soft cool daylight.

generation.note: Original retained; no regeneration. PNG not committed.
